positions.commentary: The speaker argues that Travis Kalanick only changed after realizing the violence was systematic, similar to Shaka Senzo, and that this realization is unusual and difficult to achieve.
The speaker states that in a place where lives are on the line, you cannot have a leader that lets a culture where safety is not the priority stand.

The speaker recounts a story from Andy Grove's book about a floating point error that was a huge catastrophe for Intel, noting that consumers care about how things feel more than the actual technical answer.
The speaker recounts the Silicon Valley folklore story of Reed Hastings, CEO of Netflix, regarding his vision to evolve the company from DVD to streaming.
